Ba(OH)₂ gives 2 OH⁻ per formula unit:

\[
n(\text{Ba(OH)}_2)=0.300 \times 0.3=0.090\text{ mol}
\]

\[
n(OH^-)=2(0.090)=0.180\text{ mol}
\]

Excess OH⁻:

\[
0.180-0.130=0.050\text{ mol}
\]

Total volume:

\[
500+400+300=1200\text{ mL}=1.200\text{ L}
\]

\[
[OH^-]=\frac{0.050}{1.200}=0.04167\text{ M}
\]

\[
pOH=-\log(0.04167)=1.38
\]

\[
pH=14-1.38=12.62
\]

Answer: D
